proposalGuidance: Expose only the two closed read-only observations justified by this Change; do not expose a generic OpenSpec command executor.
Project only required machine fields into Flowkit types; do not turn raw stdout/stderr/nextSteps/actionContext/arbitrary CLI results into stable public contract.
Invoke only the resolved managed OpenSpec entrypoint via process.execPath and argument-array child process without shell/PATH fallback.
Canonicalize and exact-match requested repository root against OpenSpec-reported root.path on successful observations.
Keep non-zero valid OpenSpec machine outcomes distinct from transport/malformed-output failures without recreating OpenSpec lifecycle semantics.
Do not modify Policy, Memo, Action lifecycle, Run/Result, authority, Skills or self-hosting behavior in this Change.
